en: An illustrated maritime postcard showing a large ocean liner at sea, viewed from the front-left bow. The ship has a black hull with a red waterline, white superstructure, and a single large funnel painted red with a black top, characteristic of the Cunard Line. Smaller boats are visible in the foreground on choppy water, and the sky is partly cloudy with evening light. Printed text along the bottom margin identifies the vessel as the new Cunard ship Laconia and notes its tonnage.
